aboutMe.bio.p1: Hi! My name is Anna Lednicka, and I'm someone who once dared to choose their dream. I was born in Ukraine, studied at a medical university and became a general practitioner. But in my fourth year I fell in love with photography, and that passion completely took over. I combined working as a nurse with photography until I finished university and realized: photography is my true calling.
aboutMe.bio.p2: Now I live in Slovakia, starting everything from scratch. It isn't easy, but I'm driven by the dream of making photography my profession. I'm a wife, a mother, and someone who believes it's important to do what brings you alive from within.
aboutMe.bio.p3: What do I love most about my work? The moments. Real, living emotions, not just staged shots. During our sessions you don't need to worry about how to pose or where to look. I create an easy, pleasant atmosphere: I give you something interesting to do, you do it, and meanwhile I capture the honest emotions. You start having fun, and the shoot turns into unforgettable time spent — with me, with yourself, with your family or with your other half.
aboutMe.bio.p4: I'm convinced that photographs taken with soul preserve these moments for a lifetime. Let's create them together!

galleryType.wedding.description.0.headli: Wedding photography is more than just a picture.
galleryType.wedding.description.0.conten: It's a memory of your extraordinary day, full of emotion, love and joy. My goal is to capture natural moments, gentle touches, and the smallest details that together make up your unique story.
galleryType.wedding.description.1.conten: About a month before the wedding we'll meet to go through the day's timeline, your wishes, and the key moments you want captured on camera. This preparation helps make your wedding day calmer and more enjoyable — you can fully enjoy it without unnecessary stress.
galleryType.wedding.description.2.headli: A great recommendation — a pre-wedding "love story" session
galleryType.wedding.description.2.conten: During this short and relaxed session you'll get a feel for what it's like working with me, and you'll end up with beautiful photos you can use for your wedding — in invitations, decorations, or as a slideshow. Afterwards we'll sit down together, go through all the details, your expectations, and fine-tune the day's timeline. This experience helps us get to know each other better, which significantly lowers the stress on the wedding day itself — at least in that respect you'll feel more at ease.
galleryType.wedding.tips.0.headline: Prepare your details in advance.
galleryType.wedding.tips.0.content: Gather the rings, invitations, perfume, shoes and bouquet in one place. It saves time, and I can beautifully photograph them before you get dressed.
galleryType.wedding.tips.1.headline: Take a moment to pause.
galleryType.wedding.tips.1.content: During the day, consciously give yourself a moment just for the two of you. Remember, the day is about you two — not just the schedule. The most beautiful moments happen in these quiet, honest instances.
galleryType.wedding.tips.2.headline: Leave more time for getting ready.
galleryType.wedding.tips.2.content: Mornings always fly by faster than you'd think. Set aside at least 15–20 minutes more than you think you'll need, for peace of mind.
galleryType.wedding.tips.3.headline: Don't be afraid of emotion.
galleryType.wedding.tips.3.content: Tears, laughter, hugs — all of it makes for strong, unforgettable photographs. Being authentic means being beautiful.
galleryType.wedding.tips.4.headline: Trust your photographer.
galleryType.wedding.tips.4.content: Some poses or locations might seem odd at first glance, but the result will be worth it. Sometimes the most boring wall makes for the most beautiful photo.
galleryType.wedding.tips.5.headline: Golden hour is your friend.
galleryType.wedding.tips.5.content: Plan your couple's session for just before sunset — the light will be soft, warm, and very flattering.
galleryType.wedding.tips.6.headline: Have a plan B.
galleryType.wedding.tips.6.content: If the wedding is outdoors, think about umbrellas, shelter, or an alternate location — so the weather doesn't catch you off guard.
galleryType.wedding.tips.7.headline: Let's photograph the guests too.
galleryType.wedding.tips.7.content: Don't forget to make a list of people you'd like a photo with. In the rush of the wedding it's easy to forget someone.
